description: NASA's Land Information System Framework combines terrestrial hydrology models, data assimilation and verification tools. Led by the Hydrological Sciences Laboratory at Goddard, the suite includes LDT for land parameters and forcing preparation, LIS for simulation and uncertainty analysis, and LVT for comparing results with observations. Inputs are land-surface parameters, meteorological forcing and satellite or ground observations; outputs are land-surface states, fluxes and evaluation statistics. Domain, grid resolution and simulated period are configured for each application. Main source is free under Apache-2.0, while bundled third-party components retain separate licences. A limitation is that physical options and dependencies vary, including a submodule requirement for NoahMP-5, and calibration remains application-specific. LISF can provide water-balance and environmental inputs for infrastructure simulations. ERA5 (data-era5-reanalysis) is related meteorological forcing. Public documentation supports reuse. No model archive, forcing data or environment was downloaded.
